title: Whirlpool 9kg Heat Pump Dryer WFHPM22 $749.98 ($500 off RRP) Delivered @ Costco Wholesale (Membership Required)
body:
Deal: Whirlpool 9kg Heat Pump Dryer WFHPM22 $749.98 ($500 off RRP) Delivered @ Costco Wholesale (Membership Required)

[PinzVidz] Pick it a mile away, these will be made for Whirlpool by Midea. I have the Esatto version, about 5 years old now, no issues.
[Super8Tab] Looks like a good deal. For reference we switched to Westinghouse heat pump dryer from good guys 2 years ago instead of our old ventilated dryer and i can vouch for saving in electricity, However, the most annoying thing is when washing sheets, they just clump together into a ball and always come out damp, I tried different settings, including the one that's specifically supposed to be for sheets, and the same issue still happens!
Could be my current dryer so I am tempted to try this one, but not sure if the above is a common issue across all heat pump dryers
[gadgetfreak28] We were experiencing the same with another heat pump dryer when my neighbour advised using dryer balls and only 1-2 sheets at a time. They now dry perfectly but it does take a while when you have multiple sheets to dry on the same day.
[drup] How much are people saving from going from a convection to heat pump?
[Dangerkiss] I dont know how much Im saving. I just like the fact that I can run it on a battery connected to an inverter. Better than paying 45 cents a kilowat during peak times.
[triple675] Heat pump is extremely efficient. About 35/40c of electricity per load (0.9kwh for a 10kg load) Condenser dryer is around 6 times as much as this
[triple675] SA REPS rebate is not available for general public anymore. You need to fit in an priority group to apply, ie on financial hardship
[atlas] I wouldn't recommend - dust gets through all the way to the heated fins and it's a pain to clean
[toastpaint] Is this an issue on similar LG Heat Pump dryers?
[Wolfhound] Vic has $60 rebate for this model. Apply here I believe (not sure how likely you will get it back but worth a shot?)
https://mactradeservices.com.au/victoria/appliances
[ARCHIEG17100] Would Appliances Online match this price?
[TrustNoBody] i tried to get a few companies to price match something from costco and they refused too as costco needs a membership
